slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit (with the 3000-yuan figure being a minimum-profit constraint), or is it to minimize total weekly cost while meeting a 3000-yuan profit target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize weekly profit, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity, nor about any secondary objective weighted by process hourly costs.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle time or a secondary objective, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and omits any idle-time objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 idle-time minimization objective remained unresolved and was silently omitted.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective and most constraints, but failed to ask about the P1 idle-time minimization objective and silently assumed it was irrelevant.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
